description: In review for REVIEW_GRACE_DAYS (2) days: now it is news.

lines: On 2026-09-20, the WhatsApp reminder went out in the older layout, **"project_checkin"**, because the newer one, **"project_checkin_v2"**, could not be used: Meta is still reviewing it. To check it, run `python -m reminder --whatsapp-template-status` in the second-brain folder.
